# Kinematics analytic fixtures

These fixtures are deterministic and generated by
`benchmarks/kinematics_fixtures.py`. They cover uniform linear and quadratic
motion, VFR motion, sinusoidal and exponential models, missing segments,
fixed-seed noise/outliers, angular wrapping, and path distance.
The catalog also includes the four boundary fixtures required by the work
order: `constant_series`, `insufficient_samples`, `duplicate_time`, and
`very_small_dt` (the latter two are rejection/numerical-safety inputs).

The manifest records the semantic cases without duplicating large arrays in
Git. Tests and benchmarks generate values from the documented equations and
compare engine outputs with the analytic parameters.
